nvitk.segmentation.hull_edt¶

Convex hull and Euclidean distance transform helpers for binary masks.

Functions¶

convex_hull_slicewise(→ nvitk.types.Image | Any)

Apply a 2D convex hull independently on each slice orthogonal to axis.

convex_hull_3d(→ nvitk.types.Image | Any)

Fill the 3D convex hull of all foreground voxels.

distance_transform(→ nvitk.types.Image | Any)

Euclidean distance transform of the background (outside foreground).

Module Contents¶

nvitk.segmentation.hull_edt.convex_hull_slicewise(mask: nvitk.types.Image | Any, *, axis: int = -1) → nvitk.types.Image | Any¶

Apply a 2D convex hull independently on each slice orthogonal to axis.

Non-zero voxels in each slice are filled to their planar convex hull.

nvitk.segmentation.hull_edt.convex_hull_3d(mask: nvitk.types.Image | Any) → nvitk.types.Image | Any¶

Fill the 3D convex hull of all foreground voxels.

nvitk.segmentation.hull_edt.distance_transform(mask: nvitk.types.Image | Any, *, spacing: Tuple[float, float, float] | None = None, radius_mm: float | None = None) → nvitk.types.Image | Any¶

Euclidean distance transform of the background (outside foreground).

When radius_mm is set, return a binary tube (distance ≤ radius_mm). Otherwise return float32 distance (mm if spacing is provided).
